findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Gate
Case: normal use - the full test suite checks a resumed Codex cold read.
Removing the effort from the resume config breaks the existing assertion in tests/test_codex_reader.py:127-130. That test resumes after failed and discarded reads, then expects the stub's answer to include model_reasoning_effort. The stub at tests/stubs/codex-app-server:50-52 and 177-191 echoes the resume config, which now lacks that field, so the test fails. Update the test to check the effort on the turn while retaining its cold-read assertions.
findings.title: Gate: test_10_the_cold_read_runs_on_the_other_family

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - the coordinator reports the post-release comparison.
The proof list maps the measurement criterion to this test, but it checks only the recorded efforts; its stand-in provides no token usage, and the assertions do not check a before-and-after comparison by item kind or a report. The test therefore passes even if the promised measurement and report never happen. Add separate proof for the scheduled comparison and report.
